_about: Edit this list to steer the weekly refresh. Nothing here is code. exclude_title_contains: any event whose title contains one of these words is skipped. featured_title_contains: the soonest matching event becomes the big feature at the top of the slide. venue_names: friendly venue names for street addresses. descriptions: your own wording for a specific event title.

descriptions.urban wine walk: A self-guided afternoon wandering the Mount’s coolest venues, tasting local wines and meeting the winemakers.
descriptions.louis baker: The acclaimed multi-instrumentalist and songwriter celebrates his second album, Trouble, on a nationwide tour.
descriptions.little big markets: Live music, coffee, street food, market stalls, workshops and games – a monthly market with great community vibes.
descriptions.flamingo pier: After a decade building dancefloors worldwide, Flamingo Pier come home with a full live band to launch their new album.
descriptions.mudhoney: Seattle grunge legends return to New Zealand for the first time in over a decade, for a run of intimate shows.
descriptions.run the runway: A family-friendly community fun run on an airport runway as the sun sets – a rare chance to run it.
descriptions.mount comedy club: A big night of stand-up comedy at the Mount’s monthly comedy club.
descriptions.gindulgence: New Zealand’s most celebrated gin festival – an afternoon of tastings and cocktails from the world of NZ spirits.
descriptions.city to surf: The iconic beachfront run with its sand finish line – with the City to Surf, half marathon and 5 km on offer.
descriptions.no days off: An international line-up and the best of the local scene take over Soper Reserve for one big Friday night.
descriptions.tinman triathlon: Triathlon Tauranga’s Tinman race, with standard, sprint and short distances for all levels.
descriptions.divas: A night of hits from the greatest female artists of our time, with a sprinkle of festive tunes.
descriptions.weet-bix: Kids aged 6–15 swim, cycle and run their way around age-appropriate courses – a fun day out for everyone.
descriptions.surfbreaker: An iconic Mount event that turned 40 in 2024, with the swim leg in the surf at Main Beach.
descriptions.famous last words: Mount Maunganui’s big New Year’s Eve festival, with four stages for the first time and 17+ international artists.
descriptions.kingston calling: A new two-day music and culture festival bringing the biggest artists from Aotearoa and the Pacific to Bay Oval.
descriptions.ten tenors: Ten voices, 30 years, one unforgettable night from the world’s longest-running classical crossover act.
descriptions.abba new years: Bring in the New Year with the best ABBA vibes at The Rising Tide.
descriptions.house & garden tours: Aotearoa’s largest charity house tours, with some of the area’s most inspiring homes and gardens.
descriptions.regenerate fashion: A curated mix of local sellers and vintage fashion, in the heart of Mount Maunganui.
descriptions.re:generate fashion: A curated mix of local sellers and vintage fashion, in the heart of Mount Maunganui.
descriptions.marra sprint: The Mount’s signature sprint-distance triathlon: a 750 m swim along the shore, 20 km cycle and 5 km run.

_about_experiences: experiences: the activities shown on the Local Experiences slide, in this order. Only 'slug' is needed (the last part of the listing's web address on bayofplentynz.com/explore/). Optional: tag, title, desc, note, price, months (e.g. [10,11,12]) to use your own wording. Each week price, hours and photo are re-read from the site; a listing is left out automatically if it shows a 'closed' notice or has no photo.

experiences.title: Mount Hot Pools
experiences.desc: Relax outdoors in 32–39°C ocean water under the Mount, surrounded by golden beaches and cafés.

experiences.title: Mount Surf School
experiences.desc: Daily surf lessons for every level, from absolute beginner to advanced, at one of New Zealand’s best surfing beaches.

experiences.title: Stand Up Paddle Boarding Lesson
experiences.desc: An introductory lesson with Mauao Adventures – learn the basics and get out on the water.

experiences.title: Mount Water Bikes
experiences.desc: Pedal a water bike on the shores of Pilot Bay – a locally owned and operated rental business.

experiences.title: Electric Bike Hire
experiences.desc: Mid-drive electric bikes to hire from the Electrify.nz store in Mount Maunganui.

experiences.title: Mount Maunganui Town Hīkoi
experiences.desc: A small-group guided walk through the historical and cultural sites of Mount Maunganui.

experiences.title: Māori History & Culture Tour
experiences.desc: A local storyteller, descended from the area’s tribes, guides you through Māori settlement and culture around Tauranga Moana.

experiences.title: Hobbiton Movie Set Tour
experiences.desc: Step into Middle-earth on a day trip from Tauranga to the world-famous Hobbiton Movie Set, with coastal views and countryside.

experiences.title: Rotorua Culture & Geothermal Tour
experiences.desc: An immersive six-hour journey through the culture, geothermal wonders and natural beauty of Rotorua and the Bay of Plenty.

experiences.title: Classic Flyers Aviation Museum
experiences.desc: A historic aviation museum combined with a first-class café and bar – a great option on a showery day.

experiences.title: Mount Maunganui Scenic Flight
experiences.desc: Soar above Mount Maunganui, its beaches and Matakana Island on a 30-minute scenic flight.

experiences.title: Skydive Tauranga
experiences.desc: A one-minute freefall from 15,000 feet, with views of beaches, volcanoes and Whakaari White Island.

experiences.title: Snapper & Kingfish Fishing Charter
experiences.desc: Half a day targeting snapper and kingfish with an experienced crew – take your fresh catch home.
